schemes.scheme_name_verbatim: A 5-AI-Role Model Across the OSCE Life Cycle

dimensions.definition_quote: AI functions in OSCEs should be decomposed into distinct roles (“5 AI roles”) to reduce uncontrolled automation
dimensions.locator: A 5-AI-Role Model Across the OSCE Life Cycle
dimensions.quote: We refer back to Figure 1 as we outline the roles and the accompanying safeguards.

schemes.scheme_name_verbatim: Governance Pillars: Human Oversight, Transparency, Ethics and Safety, and Traceability

dimensions.definition_quote: First, human oversight ensures that AI remains advisory.
dimensions.locator: Governance Pillars: Human Oversight, Transparency, Ethics and Safety, and Traceability
dimensions.quote: First, human oversight ensures that AI remains advisory.

dimensions.definition_quote: learning process transparency is about showing how results were produced.
dimensions.locator: Governance Pillars: Human Oversight, Transparency, Ethics and Safety, and Traceability
dimensions.quote: For assessments, it means keeping machine-readable blueprints, station rubrics, persona cards, and logs that capture who did what, when, and on which evidence.

dimensions.definition_quote: ethics and safety demand deidentification, data minimization, and guardrails against clinical misinformation, scope-of-practice drift, and inappropriate content.
dimensions.locator: Governance Pillars: Human Oversight, Transparency, Ethics and Safety, and Traceability
dimensions.quote: Safety checklists and red teaming apply to AI-SP prompts and assessment assistant outputs before deployment and after significant model updates.

dimensions.definition_quote: traceability links choices to evidence across time.
dimensions.locator: Governance Pillars: Human Oversight, Transparency, Ethics and Safety, and Traceability
dimensions.quote: Standardized logs connect scores to time-stamped utterances or actions, raters, and model versions.

schemes.scheme_name_verbatim: Three practical indicators of substantial AI

dimensions.definition_quote: AI use must be disclosed if it is intentional and substantial.
dimensions.locator: Table 2: Three practical indicators of substantial AI
dimensions.quote: Using AI to design experiments, draft sections, translate papers, summarise or paraphrase content, analyse or visualise data, or extract systematic review data

dimensions.definition_quote: Validate C2PA/Content Credentials; display a public panel.
dimensions.quote: If a manifest is malformed/forged on high-risk content, reject with rationale + appeal.
